text_block_list.text:
—The day of that exhibition race finally 
arrived. Shinko Windy was in the studio 
answering pre-race questions in an 
interview.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Windy-chan is super strong, so 
winning is gonna be a total breeze!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! As expected of the favorite! You're 
overflowing with confidence. Are there any 
rivals on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't care, nanoda! Forget about the 
other girls, take more pictures of 
Windy-chan, nanodaaa!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's been a while since I've seen 
a kid with such big talk! Young folks 
these days are all so humble and polite, 
so it's actually refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I totally get it~! ...Let's see, 
the 2nd favorite is number 7, Yamato 
Marine! She's a great runner too~!

—After the studio photoshoot, we headed 
over to the racetrack. And at last, the 
race begins—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Go-o-o-o! Do your best-t-t-t!! Windy~~~! 
We're rooting for you-u-u-u!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Kgh...! That girl...! Why on earth is she 
so fast!?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And look at that, Shinko Windy bursts out 
from the pack with a sharp late kick! Can 
she catch up from hereee!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(I shall overtake them! Faster, 
faster...!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? *pant, pant*...! Dam... mit...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Why isn't the gap closing...! I'm so 
close...!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(No way... This is wrong... Windy-chan is 
supposed to win...! Windy-chan is the 
strongest!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(No... No, no, no, no! I have to win, or 
else............!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Because we trained so hard! Morning, 
noon, and night...!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I decided to win! Even though 
Windy-chan has "ambitions"!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(If I lose in a place like this... then 
"100 years from now" is out of the 
question...!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Which one is it!? Which one is it!? You've 
got this! Catch up! Go, gooo! Marine, hold 
on! Yamato Marineee!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Shut up! Shut UUUUUP! Don't you dare call 
out someone else's naaaaame!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *CHOMP*!!

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marine
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaーh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"What on earth has gotten into Yamato 
Marine! She suddenly picks up speed and... 
wait, what!? What is this!? She's been 
bitten...!?"

"Yamato Marine holds on to cross the 
finish line in first. Having lost her 
balance after attempting a bite, Shinko 
Windy finishes in second place."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Uh... this is an unprecedented 
situation... We are currently reviewing 
the replay footage—

After the inquiry... it was determined not 
to be an "interference."

The opponent she bit wasn't injured, and 
what's more, she even let them win. It was 
deemed that 'it was not an action that put 
the opponent at a disadvantage.'

Shinko Windy wasn't demoted or 
disqualified, but she received a severe 
warning...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you kidding me!? What is she 
doing? If she hadn't tried to bite her, 
she would've won that easily.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: B-Because... but...

"The 'Biting Incident' became known across 
all of Japan in the blink of an eye..."

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see the news? It's crazy. 
It's that girl Shinko Windy, right? It's 
seriously hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not joking. Ugh, she seemed pretty 
slack to begin with, but this is 
ridiculous... What on earth is she 
thinking—

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
Was the instruction at the academy really 
thorough enough? To resort to violence 
during a race is...

text_block_list.name: Online Post
text_block_list.text:
"Well, she's an energetic Umamusume..." 
"Yamato Marine got so lucky lololol" 
"Biting Windy-san is so cute, I'm dying"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...*pout*.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm listening, ya know. If I bite, it 
won't be a proper race. And tripping is 
dangerous, so no biting... ya know.

The day after the race, I gave her a 
thorough talk. She does seem somewhat 
remorseful, but... she won't say much 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, excuse me for dropping in on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai! I saw the news... Why did 
you do something like that...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Because... I was just so annoyed...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you hear me?! Biting is 
completely out of the question—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Then... yeah...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Windy-chan is super busy, so just go 
away already...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to go apologize with my Trainer, 
bringing a box of sweets along.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
choice_data_list:
So that's how it is. Sorry, but maybe next 
time.

So that's how it is. Sorry, but maybe next 
time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Sorry for bothering you right 
as you're heading out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Hey there, Trainer. Please make sure 
you keep a proper eye on that girl, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep an eye out as much as we can 
too. Okay...?
choice_data_list: Thank you both for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it, we're fellow dirt 
Umamusume after all. It's the least we can 
do for each other.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai... did something bad, but... Even 
so..."

—A few hours later. I met up with that 
girl and her Trainer in the hotel lounge 
to apologize once again...

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marine
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, thank you so much for being so 
polite...! I wasn't hurt at all, and if 
anything, it's thanks to you that I got 
1st place...

"After bowing my head, I look at Shinko 
Windy. She seems to have her own thoughts 
on the matter, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marine
text_block_list.text:
Um... is Windy-san going to be okay? I'm 
really worried about the public uproar...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally fine, nanoda! Windy-chan is 
a bad girl, after all! Stuff like that 
doesn't bother me at aaaall!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Still... um... well...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Biting during a race was a bad thing, 
apparently."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Windy-chan, just because she was 
frustrated, because she couldn't catch 
up... did something like that...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"It was dangerous. And it ruined the match 
too. That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, nanoda.

She offered an apology in her own words, 
clumsy though they were...

text_block_list.name: Yamato Marine
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Your feelings have reached me. 
Let's have a great race if we get another 
chance!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ……They were an insanely good person.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...... I caused trouble for my minion, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She's that strong... yet she has such a 
great personality too...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... she was training just as much 
as Windy-chan, or maybe even more...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And yet... without thinking about that at 
all, Windy-chan went and...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I was so frustrated and pissed off... I 
hated losing, I just went 'Ughhh!'... And 
then I just didn't know what to do 
anymore...
choice_data_list: Did you stumble over your words...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

It was surely due to her "overwhelming 
fighting spirit"... That was just how 
desperately she wanted to win.
choice_data_list:
As long as you learn from your mistakes, 
you'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...I know that... of course I do...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan won't bite anyone during races 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... pinky swear. Windy-chan is a 
baddie who keeps her promises.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biting is strictly for outside the course.

If she learns to control her fighting 
spirit, she won't repeat the same mistake 
again. Guiding her to do so is my job...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Next time for sure... I'll run 
properly, and win properly...!

Our next target is the graded Unicorn 
Stakes. Let's pull ourselves together and 
give it our all!
